description_en: Queries the database accounts of a cluster
description_zh: 查询集群的数据库账号
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-accounts --db-cluster-id amv-bp11q28kvl6880000 --account-name test_accout --engine Clickhouse --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAccounts

parameters.help_en:
<props="china">The ID of the Enterprise Edition, Basic Edition, or Data Lakehouse Edition cluster.</props>
<props="intl">The ID of the Data Lakehouse Edition cluster.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">企业版、基础版或湖仓版的集群ID。</props>
<props="intl">湖仓版集群ID。</props>
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The database account.

If you do not specify this parameter, information about all database accounts is returned
parameters.help_zh:
数据库账号。
此参数不填写时，默认返回所有数据库账号信息
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en:
The database engine. Valid values:

AnalyticDB (default): the AnalyticDB for MySQL engine

Clickhouse: the LindormTable engine
parameters.help_zh:
数据库引擎，取值：

AnalyticDB（默认）：AnalyticDB MySQL引擎
Clickhouse：宽表引擎
parameters.name: engine

AccountStatus.description_en:
The status of the account. Valid values:

Creating: The account is being created.

Available: The account is active.

Deleting: The account is being deleted
AccountStatus.description_zh:
账号状态。取值说明：
Creating：创建中。
Available：可用。
Deleting：删除中

AccountType.description_en:
The type of the account. Valid values:

Normal: standard account.

Super: privileged account
AccountType.description_zh:
账号类型，取值说明：
Normal：普通账号。
Super：高权限账号

Engine.description_en:

AnalyticDB: The AnalyticDB for MySQL engine.

ClickHouse: The wide-table engine
Engine.description_zh:
数据库引擎，取值：

AnalyticDB：AnalyticDB MySQL引擎。
